content:
We have two positions (1 left, 2 right). Each attribute (Job, Movie‑Genre, Nationality) has two possible values, each used exactly once.

1. “The person who is pakistani is on the immediate left or immediate right of the person who is a videographer.”  
   With only two people, this forces the pakistani and the videographer to be different persons (they cannot be the same, otherwise the statement would be impossible). So one person is pakistani, the other is videographer.

2. “The person who is a videographer is somewhere to the left of the person who watches animation.”
